verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API introduction says users can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec for their own tooling, and the same page describes broad API coverage (datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys). The probe's 404s were on guessed well-known paths, not the documented download location, so they do not contradict the claim, but they also do not confirm a retrievable spec. Missing for 10: the documented spec URL or format/version details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the downloaded spec is complete and machine-readable.
